$comment: Status words of Shopee's export as the live classify_status knows them (report_importer.py), with their Story 1.11 meaning; the Story 1.11 map (SHOPEE_STATUS_MAP) is read beside them. 'completed' and its Vietnamese form, and 'paid', are AWAITING (an order finished or paid is not a validated commission). Returned and refunded items are cancelled (D31). Matching is on the normalised word: lower case, accents removed, the stroked d read as d, only a-z0-9.
